hero.sub: A full-stack environment where I learn how agents function and work safely. Built out of curiosity, not for a market.
why.p1: Project Fusion is my playground and my lab in the shape of a full-stack environment. I started out to explore what Claude Code can do. Where I ended up is a productivity app with its own harness, sandboxing and trust core.
why.p2: That deepened how I work with AI. The harness I built myself shows me what matters in tooling and security. That is the purpose of this project, and it is already fulfilled.
modules.sub: A workspace built for humans and their agents. Every module is a tool both can use, in one system and on the same data.
preview.sub: One workspace for both sides. You work here, your agents work alongside you. Every view is built for that.
harness.sub: The harness is the environment an agent thinks and acts in. Building one yourself shows quickly which limits an agent needs and where tooling gets dangerous. These blocks are the result.
cta.sub: Project Fusion taught me what matters when working with AI, how it works and what can be achieved with it. With cross-domain expertise from 20 years of work experience, I see where work gets stuck. Now I can deliver the solutions that work in the real world. Whether it is a framework, a small app, a reliable AI skill or an AI workshop, every problem has a solution that fits.
cta.ask: Looking for an enabler and builder? Then I am the solution.
cta.availability: OPEN TO WORK · OPEN TO NEW ROLES
